summary:

The target video shows a live-action late-1980s/early-1990s British science-fiction sitcom scene physically inside {Sleeping_Quarters}. {Kryten_rm} stands beside the stacked recessed bunks holding a cleaning cloth after meticulously cleaning the area. {Rimmer_rm} stands near the right-side counter inspecting the work with exaggerated seriousness. {ALF} begins outside the room and later physically enters through the room entrance, joining the scene only after Kryten and Rimmer's exchange. detailed_description:

[Shot 1] Live-action late-1980s/early-1990s British science-fiction sitcom style. A medium-wide shot physically establishes {Sleeping_Quarters}. {Kryten_rm} stands beside the stacked recessed bunks holding a cleaning cloth. {Rimmer_rm} stands several feet away near the right-side counter inspecting the freshly cleaned room. The recessed bunks remain centered on the industrial gray back wall with their metal ladder on the left. The blue cushioned chair with yellow pillow remains toward the far-left side, while exposed pipes, shelves, monitors, containers, and control equipment remain integrated into the right side of the room. Both visible characters remain silent during the opening beat.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.200, camera cuts to a medium shot showing only {Kryten_rm} physically standing beside the recessed bunks inside {Sleeping_Quarters}. The industrial gray wall, bunk frame, metal ladder, exposed pipes, floor, and surrounding fixtures remain clearly visible behind and around him. Kryten gives the cleaned surface one final satisfied wipe and proudly straightens. {Kryten_rm} says, <d>[English]All done, sir.</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:03.600, camera cuts across the same physical room to a medium shot showing only {Rimmer_rm} standing near the right-side counter inside {Sleeping_Quarters}. The industrial wall, exposed pipes, counter, shelves, monitors, containers, and control equipment remain clearly visible behind and around him. Rimmer slowly leans forward and scrutinizes the cleaned area with absurd intensity. His eyes narrow as he points accusingly toward a tiny imperfection near the edge of frame. {Rimmer_rm} says, <d>[English]Does this look clean to you?</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:06.800, camera cuts to the entrance area of {Sleeping_Quarters}. {ALF} physically walks through the entrance and into the established industrial room, taking several visible steps across the floor before stopping. The doorway, gray walls, floor, pipes, and nearby room fixtures clearly surround him so that he appears naturally embedded within the same sleeping quarters rather than against the appearance of his reference image. Once fully inside the room, {ALF} looks toward a suspiciously dirty surface and says, <d>[English]I can still see remnants of Lister's curry juice.</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:11.300, camera cuts to only {Kryten_rm} beside the recessed bunks inside {Sleeping_Quarters}. The industrial gray wall, bunk frame, ladder, and exposed pipes remain visible behind him. Kryten's proud posture slowly collapses. He looks down at the cleaning cloth in his hand, then slowly examines it with mortified android concern. He remains silent.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.300, camera cuts to only {Rimmer_rm} standing near the right-side counter inside {Sleeping_Quarters}. The same counter, industrial wall, pipes, shelves, monitors, and equipment remain behind him. Rimmer pauses, lowers his accusing hand, and gives a small irritated sideways glance toward the edge of frame, visibly annoyed that someone else noticed the dirt first. He remains silent through the end.

overall_soundscape:

Steady enclosed spacecraft ambience with low ventilation hum, faint electronic equipment, subtle mechanical vibration, and cloth rubbing against metal. Soft footsteps accompany ALF's physical entrance into the room. Kryten, Rimmer, and ALF each speak only during their own established speaking shot, with no overlapping dialogue or additional intelligible speech. A restrained British sitcom audience reaction follows ALF's unexpected entrance and curry-juice observation.
